name: dev-engine: injection, hot reload & feedback
description:
Mount dev assets under a reserved same-origin path (/__shoptet-dev/entry.js, /__shoptet-dev/events, …) so a default script-src 'self' / connect-src 'self' policy works.

Marker-anchored byte-splice injection on the buffered HTML: find the comment marker, insert the <script>/<link> and hot-reload client, leave every other byte untouched — no HTML parser involved.

SSE hot reload (EventSource) served same-origin, client injected before </head>; full reload fallback when the bundle changes.

Readable error overlay replacing the raw webpack dump.

Rendered-version assertion: detect and report the Shopify-style bug class of "you believe you're testing your code and you're not" (session/cookie desync causing the live version to render instead of the partner's code) — the overlay always states which version is being rendered.

Non-blocking production-shop warning: warn when the target shop looks like production, without blocking (enforcement is Phase 4, out of scope here).

Reference: cli-greenfield.md §5.1.1.
